scenes.title: Sela at pier four
scenes.summary:
Sela Thorn offers a daytime crossing and says she will return at first light tomorrow.
She says Saltmere Mine flooded when the bell first rang forty years ago, and relays her grandmother's account of warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary:
The party finds warm floodwater and hymn pages; a page bears the pencilled name M. Brand, which Teo identifies as his sister Mira's handwriting.
Vessa and Oren suspect harbor-master Maren is involved with the cult or choir, but the search yields no further evidence.

scenes.title: The fisherman's warning
scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick
scenes.summary:
The party visits the shore at dusk despite Sela's warning and sees the exposed chapel ruins.
An unnamed fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother drags children underwater; the GM presents this as the fishermen's claim.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.summary:
At midnight, the underwater bell rings twelve times and the humming grows louder; pale figures appear in rows on the chapel floor and vanish when the bell stops.
The GM notes the choir clock at three of six, and Vessa calls for the party to leave.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive
scenes.summary:
The party plans to have Sela row them out at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide during the day to pursue Mira's trail.
Bram says he has known Maren for thirty years and that she lost a brother to the bay; the party stays at the inn as the session ends.
